releaseNotes:
## Inquiries and Monthly
- Save guest inquiries without assigning a room, including when the house is fully booked.
- Show roomless inquiries in a Monthly waiting-list row with grey dashed bars, daily counts, collapse/expand and additional overlapping inquiries.
- Open an inquiry directly from its waiting-list bar. Assign a room before confirming; existing availability checks still apply.
- Waiting inquiries do not reserve rooms or affect occupancy and meal totals.

## Guest Inbox
- Display saved emails immediately while mailbox synchronization and folder discovery run in the background.
- Keep cached folder information visible during refresh and show a clear retry message if the mail server is unavailable.
- Add loading feedback and improve the inbox layout on mobile.

## Validation
- Focused inquiry, confirmation, folder-cache, threading and reply-status regression tests.
- Desktop/mobile browser checks using isolated databases and synthetic mail, plus typecheck, ESLint and a production build.
